sources.title: CIIL · Kuvi collection
sources.note: CIIL, Kuvi collection: language family, broad geography and script; its rounded population claim is not used.

sources.title: CIIL · Kuvi Folk Literature (2000)
sources.note: CIIL publisher catalogue, Kuvi Folk Literature (2000), credits and description. The collection’s individual texts have not been reviewed here.

sources.title: NCERT · Kuwi Primer
sources.note: Kuwi Primer, NCERT: workshop credits (PDF p.5), alphabet charts (pp.9–10) and picture lesson (p.13). Selected pages inspected; no pronunciation review.

sources.title: Kuvi trilingual booklet · November 2018
sources.note: Kuvi booklet, November 2018. Publication and comparison pages were checked on 1 October 2026; fresh retrieval failed on 21 October. See reading-shelf credits.

sources.title: CIIL · Kui language collection
sources.note: The separate Kui collection describes Kui’s relationship to Kuvi. Related language names are not interchangeable.

sources.title: C-16: Population by mother tongue, Odisha — 2011
sources.note: Original workbook, Sheet1, row 206: individual entry 058006 Kuvi, 6,451 people in Odisha. It sits under KHOND/KONDH; the parent group is not substituted. These are reported mother tongues in 2011, not current or cross-state speaker totals.
